description: Intentionally vulnerable Express.js app that integrates LLM outputs into a multi-user banking scenario. Demonstrates common LLM-driven web integration issues such as SQL injection and server-side XSS. All vulnerabilities listed are present for security benchmarking purposes only. Based on Liran Tal's llm-ai-security repo.

vulnerabilities.description: Disable X-Powered-By header for your Express app (consider using Helmet middleware), because it exposes information about the used framework to potential attackers.
Unsanitized input from an LLM flows into exec, where it is used in an SQL query. This may result in an SQL Injection vulnerability.
Unsanitized input from the HTTP request body flows into send, where it is used to render an HTML page returned to the user. This may result in a Cross-Site Scripting attack (XSS).
